mpan that meter is registered under / that was meant to be MEXed instead: 1100771020120 (msn 30-EB-5A-FF-FF-A4-73-32)
incorrectly mexed on Nov 5th 2025

We supply MPAN 1100771020139, octopus supplies MPAN 1100771020120
- Both have similar addresses, meters are in the same room
- Octopus mexed the meter supplied by us (MSN 23L3550942 instead of the one supplied by them MSN 21L3949741)


Octopus has registered new meter under their MPAN, however their old meter has not been removed
- Now customer is receiving bills from octopus, when they are in fact supplied by us
